name: sendmsg
synopsis: ssize_t sendmsg(int sockfd, const struct msghdr *msg, int flags);
description: The sendmsg() system call transmits a message to another socket. It uses a msghdr structure to specify the message data, including scatter/gather arrays and ancillary data. Flags can modify the behavior, such as using MSG_CONFIRM for link layer confirmation.

parameters.name: sockfd
parameters.description: The file descriptor of the socket to send from

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Pointer to a msghdr structure containing the message data, including iovec array for scatter/gather and optional ancillary data

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitwise OR of flags to control the operation, such as MSG_CONFIRM or MSG_DONTROUTE

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes sent
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set
